package fixture

// GREEN: every no-argument Stop in the tree. These are tickers, timers, servers
// and engines; none of them returns an error a caller could act on, and the
// arity test is what keeps the several dozen `defer tick.Stop()` sites out of
// this rule's jurisdiction.

import "time"

type server interface{ Stop() }

func run(s server, e server) {
	tick := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
	defer tick.Stop()
	timer := time.NewTimer(time.Second)
	timer.Stop()
	s.Stop()
	e.Stop()
	go func() { s.Stop() }()
}
